rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone who is very angry.

example.english: I’m furious that they forgot to buy something for me again.
example.traditional: 我真係好嬲，佢又唔記得幫我買嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 nau1 keoi5 jau6 m4 gei3 dak1 bong1 ngo5 maai5 je5

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress an extreme, explosive level of anger.

example.english: I was furious when I heard those people talking rubbish.
example.traditional: 聽到班人喺度亂咁講，我嬲到爆。
example.jyutping: teng1 dou3 baan1 jan4 hai2 dou6 lyun6 gam3 gong2 ngo5 nau1 dou3 baau3
